direction: Modern creative software with restrained Latin-classical undertones

instrumenta-mark.svg.workflow: OpenAI built-in image generation for two-stage silhouette exploration, followed by deterministic SVG construction and package-source synchronization
instrumenta-mark.svg.basePrompt: Create one premium, radically distinctive application-suite icon concept for Instrumenta, a family of creative tools. This is logo exploration for a compact 16–512 px app/toolbar mark. Do NOT use letters, text, rings, orbital loops, a central vertical stem, targets, generic sparkles, gradients, or familiar corporate-logo shapes. Design a single bold asymmetric silhouette inspired by three precision instrument jaws folding together around a triangular negative-space aperture: one continuous, sculptural, slightly mechanical glyph, simple enough to recognize instantly at 16 px. It should feel AAA, refined, confident, and timeless—closer in memorability to the structural simplicity of major desktop application icons without resembling any of them. Show exactly one centered glyph on a near-black rounded-square field, using warm limestone for the glyph with one restrained coral inner facet. Flat vector-like edges, generous padding, no mockup, no shadows, no border, no caption.
instrumenta-mark.svg.refinementPrompt: Refine this Instrumenta suite icon into a much more ownable, asymmetric symbol. Keep the premium flat mechanical precision and warm limestone plus one restrained coral facet, but completely remove the rotational three-way symmetry, bolt holes, recycling/drive-like triangle, separate-piece feeling, and any resemblance to rings or orbital loops. Build one continuous compact silhouette like an invented precision clasp: a broad hooked upper jaw and shorter lower jaw interlock around a sharp off-center aperture, with one unmistakable diagonal coral insert. It must have a unique outer contour and remain readable as a 16 px toolbar glyph. Exactly one centered glyph on a near-black rounded-square field, generous padding, no letters, text, caption, shadows, gradient, border, or faux depth.
instrumenta-mark.svg.productionNote: The selected generated raster is retained as the visual source. The shipped icon is deterministic, small-size-oriented SVG geometry with the clasp silhouette and coral gauge facet.
